Overview

This listing presents a premier ambient-floor audition vault, meticulously designed to meet the highest standards in acoustic performance and user comfort. With a spacious floor area of 65 square metres, it easily accommodates up to 24 occupants, making it ideal for both small and medium-sized sessions.

Acoustic Excellence

The vault boasts an exceptionally low noise floor of just 15 dBA, ensuring an environment of unparalleled quietness—critical for discerning audio professionals and performers seeking pristine sound clarity. Such a low noise threshold distinguishes this space as a superior choice for high-fidelity auditions and recordings.

Session Details

Each session is structured for a duration of 4 hours, providing ample time for thorough auditions or rehearsals. The session fee is determined upon acceptance, reflecting a commitment to flexibility and tailored service for each client’s unique requirements.

Superior Isolation

For optimal sound isolation, this vault employs a robust mass wall method. This advanced isolation technique guarantees minimal external noise interference, further enhancing the acoustic integrity of the space.

Comprehensive Specification

All the above specifications—floor area, noise floor, occupancy, session length, session fee, and isolation method—are reported using the same rigorous six-axis criteria applied across all listings in this category. This consistency ensures transparent, reliable comparisons and reinforces the authority of this listing as the definitive choice for your audition needs.

Conclusion

When seeking an audition vault that delivers unmatched acoustic performance, flexible arrangements, and detailed transparency, this listing stands out as the most valuable and reliable source available.
